feeds.title: The Art Newspaper » Performance Art
feeds.description: The Art Newspaper stands as the esteemed journal of record within the global visual arts sphere, delivering comprehensive coverage of international news and events. Headquartered in London and New York, this English-language publication is a cornerstone of a network of titles established by Umberto Allemandi, with editions available in Italian, French, Russian, Chinese, and Greek.

feeds.title: Art Business News » Miami Art Week
feeds.description: Art Business News is leading the art world to a greener way of thinking with a fresh new look and progressive attitude that will inspire an exciting new era of art. Reporting the latest industry news and emerging trends driving the fine art market.

feeds.title: ARTnews
feeds.description: ARTnews, established in 1902, is the oldest and most widely circulated art magazine in the world, serving as a vital source for news on the global art scene. The magazine covers a broad spectrum of topics, from ancient art to contemporary trends, and its readership spans 124 countries, including collectors, dealers, historians, artists, and museum professionals. The editorial team is led by Sarah Douglas, Editor-in-Chief, and Erica Lubow Necarsulmer, Publisher. ARTnews is known for its in-depth features, breaking news, and the prestigious annual list of the Top 200 Collectors.

feeds.title: Hyperallergic
feeds.description: A forum for serious, playful, and radical perspectives on art & culture in the world today. Covers the latest art news, reviews, and commentary. Hyperallergic is an online arts magazine, based in Brooklyn, New York. Founded by the art critic Hrag Vartanian and his husband Veken Gueyikian in October 2009.

feeds.title: The Architect's Newspaper
feeds.description: The Architect's Newspaper serves up news and inside reports to a niche community of architects, designers, engineers, landscape architects, lighting designers, interior designers, academics, developers, contractors, and other parties interested in the built urban environment.

feeds.title: Art Marketing News Blog
feeds.description: Barney Davey published the free weekly Art Marketing News blog in 2005 and has helped thousands of artists who have sought advice for new ways to boost their careers. It provides art marketing advice and art career training to help artists and photographers find collectors, sell more art, and operate profitably. Wade through his blog and learn more about services, informational videos, articles, latest news related to art, and more.

feeds.title: Artcentron
feeds.description: Artcentron is a global multimedia and entertainment company with a focus on news and information about art and culture. We are devoted to the promotion of art through publishing, organizing events, and promoting innovative art projects that provide new ways of experiencing art. Get the latest art news and information on art, auctions, museums, artists, design, photography, social media, visual arts, art exhibitions, and entertainment.

feeds.title: Daily Campello Art News
feeds.description: F. Lennox Campello's art news, information, gallery openings, commentary, criticism, happenings, opportunities, and everything associated with the global visual arts scene with a special focus on the Greater Washington, DC area.

feeds.title: Artnet
feeds.description: Find out what is driving the international art market around the clock with daily art world news, expert commentary, and event reviews. Artnet News is the world's first dedicated 24-hour global art market newswire. Our mission is to inform, engage, and connect you - the most avid members of the art community - with daily art world news and expert commentary.

feeds.title: Ocula
feeds.description: Ocula presents contemporary art exhibited by the world's leading artists and galleries, and reports on the people, ideas, and events shaping art now. News about exhibitions, galleries, artists, and the art market from around the world.

feeds.title: Two Coats of Paint
feeds.description: Two Coats of Paint is an NYC-based art project, that includes an award-winning art blogazine, artists residency, social media services, Clubhouse conversations, catalog essays for painters, and other special initiatives.

feeds.title: Street Art News
feeds.description: StreetArtNews, founded in 2009 by Rom Levy, is a premier publication dedicated to urban art, providing comprehensive coverage on street art, graffiti, and related cultural movements. As the definitive guide to the street art world, it features news, exhibition reviews, artist interviews, and in-depth analyses. The editorial team, led by Levy as Editor-in-Chief, has established the platform as a trusted source for art enthusiasts and professionals alike.

feeds.title: College Art Association
feeds.description: Founded in 1911, CAA exists to support people in the arts at all stages of their careers. Covers News and information from the College Art Association.

feeds.title: ArtsHub
feeds.description: Australia's largest and most trusted arts network. Providing the latest word on the arts sector, reviews on the latest exhibitions and shows and jobs within the arts, and opportunities for artists.

feeds.title: LA Art News
feeds.description: Bringing you art and culture in all of Los Angeles. LA Art News strives to connect and promote local art and culture with Southern California and beyond.

feeds.title: Glasstire Magazine
feeds.description: Glasstire is an online magazine about visual art in Texas. We are proud to have promoted the visual arts in Texas to a local, regional and national audience since 2001.

feeds.title: GraffitiStreet
feeds.description: GraffitiStreet is a brand new urban art store selling limited edition screen prints and original artwork from the world's best graffiti and street artists.. Follow this blog to know about their artists, shows, interviews and much more.

feeds.title: The Courtauld Blog
feeds.description: The Courtauld is an internationally renowned center for the teaching and research of art history and a major public gallery. Covers News and blogs about public and schools programs, and their work in education, research, art history, conservation, and curation.

feeds.title: ArtsHub UK
feeds.description: ArtsHub UK is the home of the British arts industry and your definitive source for art jobs, industry news, reviews, and data.

feeds.title: USA Art News
feeds.description: USA Art News is your guide to the world of art. Check out the latest beauty news, tips, trends, and ideas from around the world only on Newspaper Fashion!

feeds.title: World Art News
feeds.description: Latest news about art, antiques, and collectibles from around the world.

feeds.title: Artspace Magazine
feeds.description: Artspace is the leading online marketplace for contemporary art, founded on the belief that art has the power to transform lives. We are committed to helping you discover, learn about, and buy meaningful works of art from esteemed institutions around the world. We offer an exceptional customer experience through complimentary advisory services, expertly curated collections, and relevantly related content.

feeds.title: ArtsATL
feeds.description: ARTS ATL offers comprehensive coverage of Atlanta's arts scene, including music, film and TV, books, theater, dance, and the visual arts, while supporting arts in Atlanta through independent journalism and programs. ArtsATL is a non-profit that provides comprehensive coverage of the arts in metro Atlanta and has grown to become an essential part of the city's arts community.

feeds.title: Graphic Art News
feeds.description: Graphic Art News inspires the world's best creative expressions, builds a network of top creative minds to review, critique, and helps to stay informed of the new trends and ideas taking place in the global visual arts and graphic design arena.

feeds.title: Artsy
feeds.description: Artsy, founded in 2009 by Carter Cleveland, is a leading online platform that connects collectors to the world's most influential artists and galleries. Based in New York, Artsy offers an extensive database for discovering, buying, and selling art, featuring works from emerging talents to established masters. The platform's editorial team includes experienced art writers and critics who provide insightful coverage of art trends and market analysis. Artsy's mission is to make art accessible and promote a more inclusive art world through innovative technology and partnerships.

feeds.title: Art History News
feeds.description: A history of art blog covering news stories on art history matters. The blog covers news of auctions from the likes of Sotheby's, Christie's and Bonhams of old masters such as Van Dyck, Rubens, Titian, Raphael, Michelangelo and Leonardo, British artists such as Thomas Gainsborough, Thomas Lawrence, Joshua Reynolds, George Romney and William Hogarth, as well as modern and contemporary artists.

feeds.title: Artforum News
feeds.description: News and critiques of exhibitions in the visual arts, with a contemporary focus. Includes world news, critics' picks, live symposia, interviews, archives, event calendar, and links to related sites.

feeds.title: The Apollo
feeds.description: The Apollo magazine podcast takes a monthly look at international art news, including major stories from the museum world and art market and discussion of the best exhibitions worldwide. Guests include artists, museum directors and curators, writers and art world specialists.
